bio: Welcome, 2029! Hawaii, where I grew up, will always have my heart but I have fully embraced my inner New Englander since moving into the Yard as a first-year many moons ago. Since graduating from the College, I have worn various hats in the field of education and currently work in undergraduate admissions. In my free time, I will most likely be found in a dance class, exploring greater Boston on foot, or out and about on campus with my energetic 9-year-old son (if you see us, please say hi!). I am so glad you are here and hope your year is amazing! Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
